provenance: Extracted from a full re-run of the frozen case on macOS performed during the repository integration. It records a second platform only and does not replace the frozen Linux baseline in case_summary.json.

cli_primary_warnings_json: Primary metrics evaluate the nested model-family and parameter selection procedure, not the final full-data model. Family leaderboard ranks are exploratory; choosing from their outer scores introduces selection bias. External validity requires appropriate independent data.

detail.scope: frozen baseline recorded on Linux; cross-platform float differences must be reported, never hidden

probability_difference_details.alignment_verified: row sequences, fold/observed/predicted/model identity columns, probability column order (probability_1..19), final-model classes and byte-identical hard predictions were all checked
probability_difference_details.retained_locally: full per-row/per-fold difference detail, logs and environment records are archived in the git-ignored local reports directory (not part of the commit)

golden.interpretation: Hard predictions, split membership, selection and label-based metrics are identical; only probability-derived ROC-AUC differs slightly. The difference is preserved and reported, never used to relax tolerances or replace the frozen baseline.

isolation_experiment.conclusion: Same probability inputs reproduce the same ROC-AUC on macOS (differences at the 1e-16 level), so the metric computation is not the source. The fold ROC-AUC difference follows the fitted probabilities: the final logistic models differ slightly (coefficients about 3e-5, intercepts about 7e-5) and out-of-fold probabilities differ by up to about 2e-5. Platform numerical-library paths are the standing hypothesis; no implementation-level root-cause experiment was performed, so the cause is reported as located but not fully confirmed.

canary.interpretation: One engineering canary; not an inferential permutation test, not a false-positive-rate estimate and not proof that no leakage exists.

scope.statement: Cross-platform record: Linux freeze values are not overwritten. GUI, Windows and the official locked environment remain unverified for this case.
